{{Quote|Dad was the top Star Tours pilot... 'til he took a crash course in StarSpeeders, if you know what I mean. Now he's a real basket case. Yep, that's him all over. It's a shame too, [he's] really gone to pieces.|G2-9T|<ref name="Star Tours (real-world)" />}}
'''Dad''' was a [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]] working for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel company, until he suffered an accident that destroyed him to some extent. Fellow working droid [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]] considered Dad Star Tours' best pilot.<ref name="Star Tours (real-world)" />
